[12/13/14/15 Regression] Dead Code Elimination Regression at -O3 sincer12-2637-g145bc41dae7c7bfa093d61e77346f98e6a595a0e
cat test.c

void foo(void);
static int b;
static char c;
static short a(short d, short e) { return e == 0 || d && e == 1 ? 0 : d % e; }
int main() {
  b = c = b >= 2 ? 0 : 1 >> b;
  short f = a(0 >= 0 ^ c, 5);
  if (f == c)
    foo();
  a(0, 9);
}
